Name: Malignant Chain
Effect: Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target. At the end of the Round, if the Target was Poisoned by this Move, roll their Loyalty and get at least 3 successes. If it fails, from the next Round make the Target the User's Ally until the poison is healed.
Description: This chain contains the most potent neurotoxin currently known. It boosts physical appearance, yet totally suppresses the mind and soul, turning the target into the user’s puppet.
